content.intro: This lesson introduces exploring directory trees as part of linux filesystem and directory navigation. Begin with an observation you can safely repeat, then explain what the result tells you and what it does not prove.
content.why_it_matters: Navigate the directory tree and identify common paths, file metadata, links, and name patterns.

content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: The filesystem is one hierarchical namespace rooted at /. Absolute and relative paths differ by whether they start at that root.

content_blocks.title: Guided walkthrough
content_blocks.text: First, state what you expect from the example. Run it in the intended environment, capture standard output and any error message, and inspect the exit status where meaningful. Then connect the observation to this lesson: Exploring Directory Trees. Do not infer more than the evidence supports.

content_blocks.title: Common mistake
content_blocks.text: A common mistake is to assume exploring directory trees behaves identically on every distribution, kernel, utility version, and administrative policy. Verify the installed tool and consult the matching manual before using the procedure elsewhere.

content_blocks.title: Safety and compatibility
content_blocks.text: The fallback is a deterministic practice marker; pair it with the lesson’s specific inspection task. For commands that edit files, manage services, change network/firewall state, partition disks, change permissions recursively, or alter boot settings, use an isolated VM, take a snapshot/backup, review the exact target, and prepare a recovery path before acting.

content_blocks.title: Troubleshooting and reset
content_blocks.text: If the command is missing, check whether the required package is installed and which distribution you are using. If access is denied, do not immediately escalate to root; confirm the target path, identity, and required permission. If the result differs, capture the command, output, version, and environment so the issue can be reproduced.

content_blocks.title: Recap
content_blocks.text: Remember the core relationship: The filesystem is one hierarchical namespace rooted at /. Absolute and relative paths differ by whether they start at that root. The goal is to explain the observed result, test a boundary case, and record a limitation rather than memorize a command in isolation.
